subject: Steering committee intro & exec sponsor prep - FinIntegrate
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@finintegrate.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Quick recap + next steps (steering committee / exec sponsor)

Sanjay — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can keep momentum as you prepare the steering committee: 

- Recap: You and Priya are evaluating Redwood for inference across customer-facing assistant workflows and scheduled batched reports (priority: latency for chat, cost for nightly batches).
- Key criteria you mentioned: 99th percentile latency under 400ms for short chat turns, tenant isolation for regulated data, and a predictable pricing model for forecasting.
- Stakeholders you listed: Priya (Head of Product), Alex (SRE/Infra), and procurement/legal for contract/controls. You also mentioned an exec sponsor — any chance you can confirm who that will be?

Proposal: schedule a 60-minute steering-committee intro with your exec sponsor + Priya + Alex + procurement/legal. Agenda I suggest: 1) Business goals & decision criteria (10m), 2) Security & compliance overview (15m), 3) Technical fit and runbook (20m), 4) Commercial/contract & next steps (15m). I attached a short agenda and product overview.

Can you share availability next week (Nov 2–6) and confirm the exec sponsor so we can invite the right people? Also, Alex/Procurement — if you have a security questionnaire or SOC audit cadence, share that and we’ll prep answers in advance.

Thanks — looking forward to keeping this moving.

—
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
(415) 555-0129

Attachments: Redwood_Product_Overview.pdf, Steering_Committee_Agenda.docx

From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@finintegrate.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Menon <priya.menon@finintegrate.com>, Alex Carter <alex.carter@fintegrate.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick recap + next steps (steering committee / exec sponsor)

Thanks Marissa — great notes and thanks for the agenda. A few datapoints from our side: 

- Exec sponsor is likely going to be Kavita Desai (VP, Digital Experience) — I’ll confirm by EOD Mon.
- Procurement/legal want to run our standard security/compliance intake: we’ve attached the MATP questionnaire to this thread.
- Availability: Nov 3 (AM PT) or Nov 4 (late afternoon PT) work for Priya and Alex. Kavita is currently in market travel Nov 2–3, so Nov 4 is safer.

We’d appreciate if your security/technical lead could join to cover controls and SRE integration. Also include a short note on pricing structure for Dedicated vs hosted tiers so procurement has a sense of cost model.

Appreciate it — will confirm Kavita Monday.

—
Sanjay Rao
Head of Engineering
FinIntegrate
sanjay@finintegrate.com

Attachment: FinIntegrate_MATP_questionnaire.xlsx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@finintegrate.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick recap + next steps (steering committee / exec sponsor)

Perfect — thanks for the timing. We’ll plan for Nov 4 late afternoon PT tentatively. Stephanie (technical lead) and I will cover the security/compliance and technical runbook. Vivek I’m looping in for commercial/exec alignment. 

Prep checklist from our side: 
- We’ll return the completed MATP answers by EOD Nov 2.
- Provide a 10-slide tailored deck focused on latency/cost tradeoffs and Dedicated vs Hosted economics.
- Draft commercial outline (SLA, committed capacity options, pricing bands) for procurement to review.

If Kavita confirms earlier, we can also do a short pre-brief (15m) with her prior to the steering committee — happy to coordinate.

Thanks — sending the questionnaire to Stephanie for triage.

—
Marissa

Attachments: none

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sanjay Rao <sanjay@finintegrate.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick recap + next steps (steering committee / exec sponsor)

Sanjay / Marissa — I pulled the MATP and started filling in answers; attaching the working copy. A few notes for Alex/SRE: 

- Deployment options: we’ll document a Dedicated-reserved topology and VPC/private control plane design — this addresses your tenant isolation ask.
- 99th percentile latency: for short chat flows we typically point to our verified profiles; we’ll include a latency profile for the three models you mentioned and estimated tail latency at 256-token contexts.
- Integration: recommend a staged rollout (sandbox -> staging -> prod) with prefix caching enabled. I’ll add an operations runbook section to the answers.

I’ll have the first pass back to you by COB Nov 2.

—
Stephanie Nguyen
Principal Solutions Architect
Redwood Inference
stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com

Attachments: FinIntegrate_MATP_questionnaire_filled.xlsx

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@finintegrate.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Nov 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick recap + next steps (steering committee / exec sponsor)

Sanjay — Vivek here. Thanks for progressing this — appreciate the MATP. Two quick asks from the commercial/exec side: 

1) If Kavita is confirmed as exec sponsor, would she be willing to join the full 60m session? If not, we request a 15–20m pre-brief with her and then the larger steering committee.
2) For procurement, we can prepare a draft statement of work and a one-page commercial term sheet in advance. Would you like that ahead of Nov 4 so procurement has something concrete?

If Nov 4 late afternoon PT works, please confirm a time window and we’ll send a calendar invite with the agenda and required attendees.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Sales, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com

Attachments: Redwood_Commercial_TermSheet_v1.pdf

From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@finintegrate.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Menon <priya.menon@finintegrate.com>, Alex Carter <alex.carter@fintegrate.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Nov 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick recap + next steps (steering committee / exec sponsor)

Thanks everyone — Kavita confirmed and will join the full 60m steering committee. Nov 4 at 4:00 PM PT works for our group. Please send the invite and include the agenda + any docs. Procurement asked for the commercial term sheet ahead of time, so if you can share Vivek’s one-pager today that would be great. 

Looking forward to it.

—
Sanjay

Attachments: none
